milestone_lines.line: Houston here. Scientists on Earth need data on the far side of the Moon, the side we can never see from here. Your mission: fly around the Moon, observe the far side, send that data home, and come back safely. You have a parts catalog, a budget and a mass limit. How you build the ship is up to you. Just remember the four requirements.
milestone_lines.line_ja: こちらヒューストン。地球の科学者たちが、月の裏側のデータを待っている。地球からは決して見えない側だ。ミッションは、月を回って裏側を観測し、データを地球に送り、無事に帰ってくること。部品カタログと、予算と、重さの上限がある。船をどう作るかは君たち次第だ。4つの要件だけは忘れないでくれ。
milestone_lines.opens: Design screen opens: the free parts catalog (Parts sheet), trajectory and rocket. Running totals of mass, cost, power, oxygen and fuel are always visible
milestone_lines.required: None. The team builds freely, in any order

milestone_lines.line: Let's verify before we fly. Mass against the rocket's limit. Cost against the budget. ...You're go for launch.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 飛ぶ前に確かめよう。重さはロケットの上限以内か。コストは予算以内か。……よし、打ち上げだ。
milestone_lines.required: Mass and cost are both within limits
milestone_lines.if_missed: Over mass or over budget: Houston says which, and the design screen stays open

milestone_lines.line: Launch was a success. Two days out from Earth, and the Moon is getting close. Take your seats and try your controls. Nothing can go wrong yet.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 打ち上げ成功だ。地球を出て2日、月までもう少し。席について、自分の操作を試してみてくれ。今はまだ何も壊れない。
milestone_lines.opens: All seat controls unlock (Controls sheet). Free practice
milestone_lines.required: Each seat uses one control once, in any order, or 90 s pass

milestone_lines.line: Looking good. One routine job. Life Support, switch on the oxygen tank stir, please.
milestone_lines.line_ja: いい感じだ。定期作業をひとつ。生命維持担当、酸素タンクのかき混ぜスイッチを入れてくれるかな。
milestone_lines.required: Life Support presses the tank stir switch
milestone_lines.if_missed: No input for 20 s: Houston repeats the line

milestone_lines.line: ...What was that noise?! Oxygen pressure is dropping fast. One of your main tanks is leaking, and I can't stop it from here. From now on, you decide what stays on and what goes off. I'll tell you what I see.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ……今の音は何だ!? 酸素の圧力が急に下がってる。メインタンクのどちらかが漏れている。こちらからは止められない。ここからは、何を残して何を切るか、君たちが決めるんだ。こちらは見えていることを伝える。
milestone_lines.opens: Oxygen leaks until the right tank valve is closed. Power -20%. CO2 starts rising. From here on every control is free and every resource runs in real time
milestone_lines.required: None forced. Fast, good decisions lose less
milestone_lines.if_missed: The leak keeps draining oxygen, up to the maximum loss

milestone_lines.line: ...Everyone, listen. The mission as planned is over. From here on there is only one goal: all of you get back to Earth alive. Any science you can still bring home is a bonus, and it's your call.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ……みんな、聞いてくれ。当初の計画は中止だ。ここからの目標はひとつだけ。全員、生きて地球に帰ること。持ち帰れる科学データがあれば、それはボーナスだ。どうするかは君たちが決めていい。

milestone_lines.trigger: After M06, only on the science trajectory
milestone_lines.line: There's one problem. To get better observations, you're flying a path that left the free-return trajectory. If nothing changes, you'll swing around the Moon and still not come back to Earth. You need a short engine burn before you go behind the Moon. Pilot, it's yours when you're ready.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ひとつ問題がある。君たちは観測のために、自由帰還軌道から外れた道を飛んでいる。このままだと、月を回っても地球には戻れない。月の裏側に入る前に、エンジンを短く噴く必要がある。操縦担当、準備ができたら頼む。
milestone_lines.opens: The correction burn becomes available on the Pilot seat
milestone_lines.required: Pilot does the correction burn before loss of signal. Timing is free
milestone_lines.if_missed: Not done before loss of signal: it must be done right after contact returns, with the retry penalty added

milestone_lines.line: You can't turn around. We'll use the Moon's gravity to swing you around and send you home. There are two ways back. A: burn the engine hard after the far side and get home fast. Lots of fuel, but less oxygen and power. B: a small burn and a slower trip. You save fuel, but you'll need oxygen and power for longer. Tell me before the burn window. You can change your mind until ignition.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 引き返すことはできない。月の重力を使って、ぐるっと回って帰る。帰り道は2つだ。A：裏側を抜けたらエンジンを強く噴いて、早く帰る。燃料は多く使うが、酸素と電力は少なくて済む。B：噴射を小さくして、ゆっくり帰る。燃料は節約できるが、そのぶん酸素と電力が長く要る。噴射窓の前に教えてくれ。点火するまでは変えていい。
milestone_lines.opens: Route choice opens on the Mission Planner seat. The orbit map shows both routes
milestone_lines.required: Choose route A or B any time before ignition
milestone_lines.if_missed: No choice when the burn window opens: Houston picks the route the current fuel allows

milestone_lines.line: You're about to go behind the Moon. The Moon will block our signal, so you're on your own for a while. It's also your only chance to observe the far side. What you run back there is up to you. ...You'll be fine.
milestone_lines.line_ja: もうすぐ月の裏側だ。月が電波をさえぎるから、しばらく君たちだけになる。裏側を観測できるのもこの時だけだ。何を動かすかは任せる。……君たちなら大丈夫だ。
milestone_lines.opens: Loss of signal: no Houston lines and no data transmission. The observation window opens: instruments collect data only here, and only while Moon-pointing

milestone_lines.trigger: Ship comes out from behind the Moon
milestone_lines.line: ...Houston here! Do you read me? You made it through! I can take your data whenever you point the antenna at Earth.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ……こちらヒューストン！ 聞こえるか？ よく持ちこたえた！ アンテナを地球に向けてくれれば、いつでもデータを受け取れる。
milestone_lines.opens: Signal returns. Data can be transmitted while comms are on and the ship is Earth-pointing

milestone_lines.trigger: Fixed time: 30 s after the signal returns
milestone_lines.line: Burn window is open. Navigation on, ship in burn attitude, then the two ignition switches. Pilot and Comms & Power, press them together when you're both ready.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 噴射窓が開いた。航法をON、船を噴射の姿勢に。それから点火スイッチ2つだ。操縦担当と通信・電力担当、準備ができたら同時に押してくれ。
milestone_lines.opens: The burn window opens for a fixed time
milestone_lines.required: Navigation on + burn attitude + Pilot and Comms & Power press ignition together
milestone_lines.if_missed: Presses not together: lose fuel and retry. Window missed: the return angle is off and re-entry gets harder

milestone_lines.line: There's Earth. One last hurdle: re-entry. The heat will cut our radio again. Heat shield forward, and make sure life support and navigation have power. See you on the other side.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 地球が見えてきた。最後の山場、再突入だ。熱でまた通信が途切れる。熱シールドを前に向けて、生命維持と航法に電力が回っているか確かめてくれ。向こう側で会おう。
milestone_lines.if_missed: Attitude or navigation not ready: the re-entry check gets stricter

milestone_lines.trigger: Oxygen, power and temperature all at or above the thresholds
milestone_lines.line: ...We see parachutes! Welcome home, everyone. You did great.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ……パラシュートを確認！ おかえり、みんな。本当によくやった。

milestone_lines.trigger: Survived, but a resource is below its threshold
milestone_lines.line: Splashdown confirmed. The ship is a wreck, but you're all safe. That's what matters most.
milestone_lines.line_ja: 着水を確認。船はボロボロだけど、君たちは無事だ。それが一番大事なことだよ。

milestone_lines.trigger: Oxygen or power hit 0 along the way
milestone_lines.line: ...No response. (pause) That's as far as we got. What should we have kept, and what should we have shut down? Let's think it through together, one more time.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ……応答がない。（間）ここまでだ。何を残して、何を切ればよかったのか。もう一度、一緒に考えてみよう。

milestone_lines.line: Time for the mission debrief. Let's see where each of your decisions made a difference.
milestone_lines.line_ja: ミッションの振り返りだ。君たちの判断が、どこでどう効いたのか見てみよう。
milestone_lines.opens: Report: pass/fail for the four requirements, the score breakdown, and a timeline of the resources with the team's key decisions marked
milestone_lines.required: Read the report -> press "Redesign and fly again"

reactive_lines.when: Mass is above the selected rocket's limit
reactive_lines.line: That's too heavy for this rocket. Lose some mass, or pay for the bigger one.
reactive_lines.line_ja: このロケットには重すぎる。軽くするか、大きいロケットにお金を払うかだ。

reactive_lines.line: You're over budget. Something has to come off.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 予算オーバーだ。何かを降ろさないと。

reactive_lines.line: No instruments? Then there's no science to bring home. Check the requirements.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 観測機器なし？ それだと持ち帰る科学がない。要件を確かめてくれ。

reactive_lines.line: One battery is very thin. Think about what happens if something goes wrong.
reactive_lines.line_ja: バッテリー1個は心もとない。何かあったときのことを考えてみて。

reactive_lines.line: More science on that path. Just know it won't bring you home by itself.
reactive_lines.line_ja: その道のほうが科学は多く取れる。ただ、そのままでは帰ってこられないことは覚えておいて。

reactive_lines.line: Take your time. There's more than one good answer here.
reactive_lines.line_ja: ゆっくりでいい。いい答えはひとつじゃないからね。

reactive_lines.when: Leak still open 8 s after the accident
reactive_lines.line: You're still losing oxygen. Life Support, find the leaking tank and close its valve!
reactive_lines.line_ja: まだ酸素が減っている。生命維持担当、漏れているタンクを見つけてバルブを閉じて！

reactive_lines.when: A healthy tank's valve is closed
reactive_lines.line: That's the wrong tank. Check the pressure gauges.
reactive_lines.line_ja: そのタンクじゃない。圧力計を確かめて。

reactive_lines.when: 30 s after the accident and no system switched off
reactive_lines.line: Everything is still running. Power won't last like this. What can you live without for now?
reactive_lines.line_ja: 全部ついたままだ。このままでは電力がもたない。今なくても困らないものは何だ？

reactive_lines.line: Power is at half. Look at what's running. Do you need all of it right now?
reactive_lines.line_ja: 電力が半分になった。動いているものを見てくれ。今、全部必要か？

reactive_lines.line: Power is getting low. You need to keep enough for navigation and re-entry.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 電力が少なくなってきた。航法と再突入の分は残しておく必要がある。

reactive_lines.line: Power critical! Shut down everything you can. Now!
reactive_lines.line_ja: 電力が危険だ！ 切れるものは全部切って。今すぐ！

reactive_lines.line: Oxygen is under forty percent. Check it against how long your route home takes.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 酸素が40%を切った。帰り道の長さと比べてみてくれ。

reactive_lines.line: Oxygen is very low. The faster route home may be your only option.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 酸素がかなり少ない。早く帰れるルートしか選べないかもしれない。

reactive_lines.line: It's getting cold in there. Your hands will slow down. A few minutes of heater might be worth the power.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 船内が冷えてきた。手の動きが鈍くなるぞ。数分の暖房は、電力を使う価値があるかもしれない。

reactive_lines.line: You're too cold to work well. Get some heat on.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 寒すぎてうまく動けていない。暖房を入れてくれ。

reactive_lines.line: CO2 is building up. It takes two of you to swap the filter.
reactive_lines.line_ja: CO2がたまってきた。フィルター交換には2人必要だ。

reactive_lines.line: CO2 is too high. You'll be slow and you'll breathe harder. Swap the filter now.
reactive_lines.line_ja: CO2が高すぎる。動きが遅くなって、息も荒くなる。今すぐフィルターを交換して。

reactive_lines.line: That was your last filter. Make it count.
reactive_lines.line_ja: それが最後のフィルターだ。大事に使って。

reactive_lines.when: Far side in 30 s and no instrument is on
reactive_lines.line: Far side in thirty seconds. If you want data, decide what to switch on and where to point.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 裏側まであと30秒。データが欲しいなら、何をつけてどこを向くか決めてくれ。
reactive_lines.notes: Last line before loss of signal

reactive_lines.line: I'm not getting anything. Point the antenna at Earth.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 何も届いていない。アンテナを地球に向けてくれ。

reactive_lines.when: Signal is back, data is stored, and nothing sent for 20 s
reactive_lines.line: You still have data on board. Send it, or carry it home. Your call.
reactive_lines.line_ja: まだデータが船に残っている。送るか、持ち帰るか。任せるよ。

reactive_lines.line: Good charge coming in. I can't receive data while you're pointed that way, though.
reactive_lines.line_ja: しっかり充電できている。ただ、その向きの間はデータを受け取れない。

reactive_lines.when: Burn window in 30 s and navigation is off
reactive_lines.line: Burn window in thirty seconds, and navigation is still off.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 噴射窓まで30秒。航法がまだOFFだ。

reactive_lines.when: Burn window in 30 s and no route chosen
reactive_lines.line: I need a route. A or B?
reactive_lines.line_ja: ルートを決めてくれ。AかBか？

reactive_lines.line: Fuel is low. Every turn of the ship costs a little.
reactive_lines.line_ja: 燃料が少ない。船の向きを変えるたびに少しずつ減るぞ。

reactive_lines.line: Good to hear you again. Here's what I see.
reactive_lines.line_ja: また声が聞けてよかった。今の状況を伝える。
reactive_lines.notes: Followed by the highest-priority warning that is active

reactive_lines.line: You're doing fine. Keep an eye on the gauges.
reactive_lines.line_ja: いい調子だ。計器から目を離さずに。
